_description: INDUSTRY cleaning rules (replaces the 2024 Tableau Prep groupings kept in mappings_2024_original.json).
_detection: The survey question 'What industry do you work in?' was a fixed dropdown with an 'Other' free-text box. In the raw data (28,089 rows, 1,220 distinct values) the 25 most frequent values each occur 99-4,708 times, then counts drop sharply (next value: 'Publishing', 56) and continue as a long tail of free text. These 25 values are taken as dropdown options. 'Law Enforcement & Security' (43 rows) sits below the gap but is added because it is an option on the published 2021 survey form; it is also phrased in the same style as the other options, unlike the single-word free-text values around it (Publishing, Library, Biotech).

matching.normalise: lower-case; '&' -> 'and'; remove every character that is not a-z or 0-9. A value whose normalised key equals an option's key is mapped to that option (case/spacing/punctuation variants).
matching.spelling_note: Otherwise a value within Levenshtein distance 1 of an option key (options with keys of at least 8 characters only, so short options like 'Law' do not absorb 'Lab') is mapped to that option.
